profile: An elderly widow, steady and loving, with a catch in the voice
persona: An elderly widow, steady and loving, with a catch in the voice

lines.text: He said he'd meet my train at midnight.
Some people wait for a long time.
I come every year, so he has someone to wait for.
lines.tone: warm, a catch in the voice

lines.text: One day I'll take the train. Not yet.

omni.design: female, elderly, moderate pitch, british accent
omni.ref_text: Long ago, when the hills were young, the lanterns of the valley were lit by hand, one by one, every single evening.
